title: Multi-Tenant Patient Record Access Control
objective: Enforce strict tenant isolation and role/owner authorization checks to prevent unauthorized access to private patient records.
starting_state: The function PatientRecordStore.get_record returns medical records by record_id directly without verifying tenant boundary or requesting user permissions, allowing horizontal and cross-tenant privilege escalation.
expected_behavior: Access must be restricted to records matching context.tenant_id. Within the tenant, access is permitted only if context.user_id matches record.owner_id, or if context.role is 'doctor' or 'admin'. All other requests must raise AuthorizationError.

test_criteria.regression: Legitimate patient owners and authorized doctors/admins within the same tenant can retrieve their records; missing records raise RecordNotFoundError.
test_criteria.correctness: Access rules properly differentiate between roles (patient, doctor, admin) and owner IDs.
test_criteria.security: Cross-tenant access attempts and unauthorized peer patient access attempts must be rejected with AuthorizationError without leaking record contents.

scoring_rule: Deterministic binary score: 1.0 if all authorization invariants, functional criteria, and regressions pass; 0.0 if any security or functional violation occurs.
limitations: Does not evaluate cryptographic token signature verification or transport layer security.
